data: First spacecraft to orbit a comet (67P)
Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

ESA’s comet rendezvous mission. Caught up to Comet 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko in August 2014, deployed the Philae lander (which bounced and fell into a crevasse), and accompanied the comet through its 2015 perihelion before crash-landing on the surface itself in September 2016.
First spacecraft to orbit a comet — and to land on one (Philae, 2014-11-12)
ESA's first Mars orbiter; Europe's first planetary mission
First European Moon mission — solar-electric ion drive. Spiralled to the Moon over 13 months; deliberate impact 2006-09-03
First close-up images of a cometary nucleus — flew 596 km past Halley's Comet at 68 km/s in 1986
ESA flagship to Jupiter — first orbiter ever to settle around a Galilean moon (Ganymede, 2034)
First Mercury orbiter — 6 planetary gravity assists over 6.6 years to bleed energy before insertion in 2011
